description: PAID $0.01 USDC. New Hyperliquid HIP-1 spot token deploys: deploy time, deployer, supply and mark, from the official public info API. Research data, not investment advice. Params days, limit. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure. Returns JSON for new HIP-1 spot deploys: deploy time, deployer, supply, and mark.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

days.description: Only deploys in the last N days. Format: positive integer count of days. Example: 30. Omit for the server's current window.

limit.description: Maximum launches to return. Format: integer. Example: 50. Default: 50. Maximum: 200, as the existing tool text states.
